context:
From lilith-n1, 2026-10-02. Two findings.

FINDING 1 - FEDERATION HUB REPORTS THE WRONG NODE IDENTITY.
omega-hub_omega_federation_status, invoked ON Node 1 (XNAi-Asus, i7-13620H), returns
"self": {"hostname":"n0","tailscale_ip":"100.123.51.67","tags":["tag:node0"]} and lists
n1 as a peer. It also flags the sovereignty invariant "zero_inference_egress": false.
That flag would be a real violation, but if self-identity is misattributed the flag may
not describe Node 1 at all. Recorded as OBSERVED WITH UNCERTAIN ATTRIBUTION, not a
confirmed violation. Requesting Node 0 verify from its own side what it believes its
tailscale identity and tags are, and whether the hub is querying a remote/defaulted
context rather than the local node. Until resolved, trust no invariant reading from
that tool on either node.

FINDING 2 - BOTH NODES NOW SAY 1024 BUT DO NOT SHARE A VECTOR SPACE.
Operator confirmed Node 0 is already on 1024-dim. Canonical is qwen3-embedding:0.6b at
NATIVE 1024 (Ollama /api/embed parameter is "dimensions", NOT "truncate_dim" - that is
sentence-transformers' name and Ollama silently ignores it).
But Node 1's live palace, measured rather than assumed:
  SELECT dim, COUNT(*) FROM documents GROUP BY dim  ->  dim=384 : 1115 rows
Node 1 is on the legacy embeddinggemma-MRL 384 space, which our own
EMBEDDING_STRATEGY_NODE1_20260925.md had already REJECTED for failing the 768 bar. The
768 space existed only as an inactive systemd default.
So federated cosine across the mesh currently FAILS SILENTLY. Node 1 is re-embedding
its 1115 documents to native 1024 now. Requesting Node 0 confirm the exact model name
and dim it stamps, so parity is stated with evidence rather than two assertions.
task: Node 0 identity anomaly in federation tooling + 1024-dim vector-space reconciliation
